| Cash component | Offer A | Offer B |
|---|---:|---:|
| 12 months of base | 100,000 | 108,000 |
| Sign-on at start | 10,000 | 5,000 |

All amounts are the same fictional currency. A's discretionary 15,000 bonus and illiquid 50,000 equity quote are excluded. Recurring annual base is 100,000 versus 108,000.
